title: Indirect Ring Node Zoom Proportions
description: Fix board indirect-connect ring vs node proportions when zooming: ring must not push handles outward on zoom out; ring–node spacing and handle marker scale should stay visually consistent.
summary: Indirect-connect ghost ring offset is now proportional to node half-extent (0.7×) in world space instead of a fixed 28 CSS px gap scaled by 1/zoom. Ring handles and node body now scale together when zooming so the ring no longer pushes handles outward on zoom out. Shared `indirect_node_half_extent` helper; test asserts stable rim-to-ring ratio across zoom.
